judgement_by: Hon. Vijith K. Malalgoda, PC, J (P/CA)
keywords: Mandamus – Police investigations – Public-interest application concerning complaints arising from religious preaching/house-to-house activity – Alleged attacks, harassment, failure to investigate and malicious prosecutions – Petitioner seeking order compelling police to investigate and institute criminal proceedings – Police material demonstrating investigations, statements and reports to courts in multiple incidents – Scope of constitutional freedom to manifest, worship, observe and practice religion distinguished from claimed right to propagate – No basis established for coercive Mandamus directing investigation/prosecution – Relief refused.
legistation: Constitution – Articles 14(1)(e) and 140; Police Ordinance – section 56; Code of Criminal Procedure provisions governing police reports/investigations, though no particular section is identified in the extracted order.
